headline: Ecuador Cement Output Rises 19.1% Year-on-Year in October
summary: Cement production in Ecuador reached 482.9 thousand metric tons in October 2026, up 19.1% year-on-year. Total cement shipments rose 14.3% from October 2025 to 484.0 thousand tons.
why: Cement output and shipments serve as key high-frequency indicators for construction activity and infrastructure investment in Ecuador.

impacts.name: Ecuador
impacts.why: Increased cement production reflects growth in domestic construction activity in Ecuador.
